integrity: All mathematical statements and exact finite computations are separately described; the numerical checker is corroborating evidence and the proof is unconditional. Independent audit has not been carried out.
limitations: The theorem is for even k and power-of-two divisor counts, with specified odd-prime residue support for injectivity. It is not a solution to the unrestricted conjecture; novelty cannot be certified by finite literature searches.
title: Prime-residue recovery and injectivity of reciprocal divisor-power sums
